plan.objective: Prepare the split-binary gate test: fresh release builds, a fix for the now-broken is-grep-enough sidebench harness pointing, and the handoff/write-up scaffold for the user-supervised 347-case reference re-run against the 80.6 baseline.

.grove/config.json explore section format is unaffected (opaque passthrough per T01) — no harness config-shape changes needed beyond the server launch command.
Harness-pointing fix is prepared here but commits in is-grep-enough, not this repo, per the task's cross-repo coordination note.
Actual rig execution (llama.cpp serving base-q4-v2-hf, sidebench re-run) is user-supervised per D1 and out of scope for unattended completion in this plan.
